latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Polymarket Candle Momentum skill.
- Trades 5-minute Polymarket fast markets (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB) using 1-minute Binance candle body analysis and volume surge detection.
- Enters positions when last candle body >60% of range and volume >1.5x 3-candle average.
- Backtested with 84–86%+ win rate over 3 months.
- Dry-run by default; live trading enabled with --live flag and SIMMER_API_KEY.
- Configurable thresholds and assets via CLI or environment variables.
